scene: the center welcome sheet as a single printed page

scene: the arrival form on paper half filled in by hand
props: nine fields; handwriting in the filled fields; the emergency contact field left blank; a signature line
style: real form layout; handwriting in a separate hand from the printed labels

scene: a cutaway diorama of Room 4 seen from the front corner
